scope: Three original 137-case mouth freshener categories; original signed 22 Sep 2021 FSSAI Section 16(5) direction and FoSCoS listing; source classification only, not legal product approval.

official_evidence.hosting: Signed copy hosted on PFNDAI (not the FSSAI web server)

order_2021_reading.clause_3: Creates the three 5.2.4 mouth freshener categories as interim licensing classifications (text says no specific FSSR standard for mouth fresheners then).
order_2021_reading.clause_4: General Manufacturing KoB uses 5.2.4.x for licensing; petty food manufacturers and other KoBs directed to broad 05 for application.
order_2021_reading.clause_5: These subcategories shall comply with the horizontal parameters of the largest/major ingredient; category 5.2 permitted additives shall be applicable.
order_2021_reading.clause_6: Already licensed FBOs need not modify simply for new category; new/renewal licenses after order use these categories.

mandatory_evidence_for_largest_major_ing: Identify which actual dried fruit, vegetable, nut or seed supplies the largest mass share; get botanical identity and food part
Check whether the ingredient is whole, ground, candied, roasted or otherwise processed; select applicable raw commodity or processed food articles
Screen actual high-risk ingredient class for relevant mycotoxins, metals, pesticide residues and allergens without inferring any particular value
records.category_specific_wrong_article_inherita: Do not automatically transfer the dried fig, arecanut, tree nut, seed or generic dry-fruit contaminant row to an unidentified mixed mouth freshener.

records.published_catalogue_title: Other traditional mouth fresheners not covered under 5.2.4.1 and 5.2.4.2
records.published_category_description: Other traditional mouth fresheners not covered by 5.2.4.1/.2
mandatory_evidence_for_largest_major_ing: Specify each ingredient and its proportion; prove product is not class 5.2.4.1 or 5.2.4.2 rather than treating .3 as a fallback for missing evidence
Determine largest/major actual ingredient and its applicable horizontal safety parameters, species/grade and manufacturing process
Verify whether the real recipe is separately standardized (e.g., Pan Masala) or requires another licensing/approval route
records.category_specific_wrong_article_inherita: Other traditional is a residual category, not a permission to include otherwise prohibited or unassessed botanical/chemical substances.

mandatory_evidence_for_largest_major_ing: Identify exact major culinary spice(s), species, plant part, percentages and whether fresh, dried, roasted, ground or blended
Evaluate source-appropriate spice metal, aflatoxin, pesticide and analytical matrix requirements with effective notification
Independently check fragrance/colour/flavour and carrier additives in actual formula against category 5.2 conditions
records.category_specific_wrong_article_inherita: Do not presume a prepared spice mouth freshener is legally the same article as dried raw spice, spice mix, Pan Masala or a generic category 12.2.1 substance.

common_sku_evidence_gates: Actual FBO licence and KoB, renewal date and registered FoSCoS category
Full quantitatively declared recipe; largest/major ingredient identity and supplier/lot
Ingredient species, food part, processing state, purity, raw commodity standards, and any proprietary status
Each added colour, flavour, sweetener or processing aid: INS, specification, concentration and Appendix A Category 5.2 permission with effective amendments
Correct current food-law and CTR whole-product versus raw-ingredient article, exceptions, sampling basis, full analyte panel, validated methods and results
Allergens, legal labelling, packaging, claims, microbiology and separate Pan Masala classification when formula warrants
